question: What is the benefit of using the Cisco Nexus Dashboard single sign-on feature?
options: It provides notifications about end of sale for the deployed switches.
It adds a security layer based on multifactor authentication.
It manages operations of the infrastructure using a single pane of glass.
It allows the user to switch seamlessly between the hosted services.
theory: The benefit of Nexus Dashboard's Single Sign-On is that once a user authenticates, they can move seamlessly between the different hosted services running on the shared platform — Insights, Orchestrator, Fabric Controller, individual APIC/site GUIs — without re-authenticating for each one, unifying what would otherwise be several separate logins into a single session. It is not itself a notification mechanism, a multifactor-authentication hardening feature, or a single-pane-of-glass operations dashboard, since those are separate Nexus Dashboard capabilities. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 7 — Nexus Dashboard Single Sign-On)
